name: Composite Cross Domain Variant 1
task:
Please complete the following four-stage multi-domain task.

A company's annual report (25 pages) contains: revenue $8M, costs $5M, 3 departments. Each department proposes a project: Dept A ($200K, 25% ROI), Dept B ($350K, 18% ROI), Dept C ($150K, 30% ROI). Total budget: $500K.

Calculate NPV of the investment.

Optimize budget allocation.

Recommend the best course of action.

subtasks.name: Report data extraction and information retrieval
